entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane of adventure with treasures and potent mana, where mana and gravity work differently and floating hedrons litter the landscape; home plane of the Kor.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Large floating polyhedron-shaped stones on Zendikar whose purpose even the natives do not know.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A race native to Zendikar, featured as the white race; their appearance on Rath and other planes is due to abductions from Zendikar.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker introduced as a new planeswalker in the set, previously featured in Duels of the Planeswalkers.

entities.name: Chandra Ablaze
entities.description: A planeswalker who stars with Sarkhan Vol in the Journey to the Eye webcomic.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker introduced in the set.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A character in the Journey to the Eye webcomic.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis, the Fallen
entities.description: A character featured in booster artwork.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A plane where Kor appear because of abductions from Zendikar.

events.summary: Zendikar is established as a new plane, previously only alluded to in the Planeswalker novel The Purifying Fire.
events.quote: had been alluded to within the Planeswalker novel of The Purifying Fire

events.summary: It is revealed that the Kor's appearance on Rath and other planes is due to abductions from Zendikar.
events.quote: It is revealed that their appearance on Rath and other planes is due to abductions from Zendikar.
